commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(ci): add automatic provisioning deployment to Fly.io
commits.body:
Deploys provisioning service to Fly.io after cloud-agent image is built.
Triggers after Build Cloud Agent Image workflow completes successfully.
Also supports manual dispatch for emergency deploys.

Requires FLY_API_TOKEN secret to be configured in GitHub.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.stat:
53b68b9 feat(ci): add automatic provisioning deployment to Fly.io
 .github/workflows/deploy-provisioning.yml | 39 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 39 insertions(+)
commits.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/deploy-provisioning.yml b/.github/workflows/deploy-provisioning.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0a84acb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy-provisioning.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+name: Deploy Provisioning Service
+
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: ["Build Cloud Agent Image"]
+    types: [completed]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  deploy:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Setup Fly.io CLI
+        uses: superfly/flyctl-actions/setup-flyctl@master
+
+      - name: Get version
+        id: version
+        run: |
+          VERSION=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
+          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          echo "Deploying version: ${VERSION}"
+
+      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
+        working-directory: claude-remote-control/apps/provisioning
+        run: flyctl deploy --remote-only
+        env:
+          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Verify deployment
+        run: |
+          sleep 10
+          curl -sf https://247-provisioning.fly.dev/health || echo "Health check endpoint not available yet"

commits.subject: feat(web): add cloud config access button to header
commits.body:
Add a Cloud icon button to the header that opens a slide-over panel
for managing Fly.io cloud configuration. The panel allows users to:
- Sign in with GitHub when not authenticated
- Connect/disconnect Fly.io account
- View and manage deployed cloud agents
- Launch new cloud agents

The button appears when cloud features are enabled via
NEXT_PUBLIC_PROVISIONING_URL environment variable.

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(cloud): add auto-sleep/auto-wake for Fly.io agents
commits.body:
- Enable autostop: 'stop' so machines sleep when idle (saves costs)
- Set min_machines_running = 0 to allow full shutdown
- Rename "Stopped" → "Sleeping" with purple styling
- Rename "Starting" → "Waking up..."
- Add "Wake & Connect" button for sleeping agents
- Rename "Stop" → "Sleep", "Start" → "Wake" for clarity
- Trigger startAgent API when connecting to sleeping agent for faster wake
- Update tests for new autostop behavior

Fly.io proxy automatically wakes machines on incoming requests,
so users can connect directly to sleeping agents.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Fly.io CLI
+        uses: superfly/flyctl-action/setup-flyctl@master
+
+      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
+        run: flyctl deploy --remote-only
+        working-directory: claude-remote-control/apps/provisioning
+        env:
+          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Verify deployment
+        run: |
+          sleep 10
+          curl -f https://247-provisioning.fly.dev/health || exit 1
